figurative_meaning_en: of its own accord; without external effort
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার উদ্যোগ স্বতঃস্ফূর্ত ছিল, কোনো বাহ্যিক চাপ ছাড়াই।
example_sentences_in_english: His initiative was spontaneous, without any external pressure.
A wave of spontaneous protest arose in the meeting.
note: This term is derived from Sanskrit and commonly used in formal Bengali to denote natural emergence.
